name: io.github.serionist/omniverse-mcp
title: Omniverse MCP
description: Let an AI assistant work in NVIDIA Isaac Sim and other Omniverse Kit apps

environmentVariables.name: PYTHONPATH
environmentVariables.description: Set it empty, so a Python path that Isaac Sim's environment sets stays out of the server's Python

environmentVariables.name: OMNIVERSE_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The host of the Kit app running the ovmcp.bridge extension

environmentVariables.name: OMNIVERSE_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The bridge's port in the Kit app

environmentVariables.name: OMNIVERSE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The folder for images and long answers (default: ./mcp_output)

environmentVariables.name: OMNIVERSE_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The bridge's token, for Kit on another machine; on the same machine the server reads it from Kit
